facts.text: John decided to start the initiative because of the high unemployment in their community.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Maria. Unemployment in our community was the reason behind it.
Seeing the effect unemployment has on our neighbors made me decide to act.

facts.text: John's initiative involved a community food drive to help those affected by unemployment.

evidence.quote: I wanted to help out in these tough times by doing a community food drive.

facts.text: John's initiative received a large amount of volunteer support.

evidence.quote: We've been overwhelmed by the response and the volunteers.

facts.text: John shared a photo of volunteers at a recent event, including a woman in a face mask holding a bag of food.

evidence.quote: Here's a photo of them at a recent event.
